A litigation matter is fundamentally different from a compliance programme. An internal audit is different from a software project. Each has its own data, processes, terminology, controls and measures of success. Yet most work management platforms reduce them to variations of the same projects, tasks and checklists.

As Founder & CEO, I lead Ekah's product strategy and direction, working closely with our customers and engineering team to rethink that model.

Ekah is built on Ekah Studio, our native workflow and business process engine. On top of this foundation, we are building Experiences — purpose-built ways of managing different kinds of enterprise work. Legal, Compliance and Assurance are among the first, while the platform continues to support standard projects and tickets.

An Experience doesn't simply change the interface. It gives Ekah an understanding of the context of the work — the information that matters, the processes that govern it, the reviews and approvals required, and the operational insights that decision-makers need.

Underneath it all is an execution platform designed for structured enterprise work: configurable workflows, multi-level reviews and approvals, rework cycles, document management, spend tracking and end-to-end traceability.

My focus now is on taking Ekah from a powerful workflow-driven platform to something broader:

[{"position": "Co-Founder & CEO", "location": "Leicester", "employmentType": "Full-time", "workplaceType": "Hybrid", "companyName": "Gideons Tech Solutions™", "companyLinkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/company/gideons-tech/", "companyId": "102698657", "duration": "5 yrs 7 mos", "description": "Gideons | Your AI & Tech Partner

At Gideons, our motto is to Embrace Tomorrow, Today.
We help businesses leverage the latest AI and technology to work smarter, serve customers better, and grow.

Our flagship product, LeadConvert™, helps businesses running paid ads turn more of the leads they're already paying for into customers. Businesses invest heavily in advertising to generate leads. But generating a lead is only the beginning. 

When leads aren't contacted quickly or followed up consistently, valuable opportunities are lost.
Leads contacted within 5 minutes are 21x more likely to qualify than those contacted after 30 minutes.
